errors.text_span: “各语体中支配动词的一级语义域分布”（图a）和“各语体中承受动词的一级语义域分布”（图b）
errors.evidence: The figure title and purpose describe '变量词的词频及分布' (frequency and distribution of variable words), not '支配动词' or '承受动词' (dominant or receptive verbs).
The x-axis categories are '新闻' (news), '学术' (academic), '网络小说' (web novels), and '微博' (Weibo). '传统文学' (traditional literature) is incorrect.
The figure shows the total frequency for '新闻' (news) in Fig (a) is approximately 5000, not 4407.
The figure shows the total frequency for '网络小说' (web novels) in Fig (a) is approximately 7000, not 6700.
The figure shows the total frequency for '新闻' (news) in Fig (b) is approximately 1000, not 130.
The figure shows the total frequency for '网络小说' (web novels) in Fig (b) is approximately 7000, not 4528.
The figure shows the total frequency for '微博' (Weibo) in Fig (b) is approximately 100, not 152.
The description omits the y-axis label '词频值' (word frequency value) and only mentions '频次' (frequency), which is less precise.
The description does not explicitly state that the bars are segmented (stacked) to represent different variable word categories, though it implies this with '多个颜色块堆叠'.
The description does not mention the absence of visual emphasis (e.g., shadows or bolding) in Fig (a).
The description does not mention the absence of visual emphasis (e.g., shadows or bolding) in Fig (b).
The legend details (e.g., '状态 (137)', '行为 (143)', '情感 (145)') are not visible or labeled in the figure. No atom supports this claim.
